consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.purpose: Record the reason for the visit, history, assessment, and plan alongside the shared examination and chart.

discharge.title: Discharge
discharge.purpose: Record the medications, care instructions, and follow-up discussed for this visit.

sourceNotice: Recorded wording stays as entered. Review the client language before sharing.

complaint.label: Reason for visit
complaint.helper: Shared with the patient details for this visit.

consultationHistory.label: History
consultationHistory.helper: Record the history provided and relevant context.

consultationAssessment.label: Assessment
consultationAssessment.helper: Record your assessment, including any uncertainty.

consultationPlan.label: Plan
consultationPlan.helper: Record the plan discussed; do not imply that planned care is complete.

dischargeMedications.label: Medications
dischargeMedications.helper: Enter only recorded medications and doses, keeping any uncertainty.

dischargeInstructions.label: Instructions
dischargeInstructions.helper: Record the care instructions discussed for this visit.

dischargeFollowUp.label: Follow-up
dischargeFollowUp.helper: Record the follow-up discussed; use the existing recall date for a scheduled recheck.

gpVitals.label: Vital signs
gpVitals.helper: Record measured values with their units and any uncertainty.

gpPhysicalExam.label: Physical examination
gpPhysicalExam.helper: Record only examination findings observed or reported.

gpDiagnostics.label: Diagnostics
gpDiagnostics.helper: Record diagnostic findings and pending tests, keeping uncertainty.

gp-exam.title: GP examination
gp-exam.purpose: Record the vital signs, physical examination, and diagnostic findings for this visit.
